plain: An official inquiry, such as one into a death.

example.quote: For misbehavior, the grand inquest of the colony, the house of representatives, should impeach them before the governor and council, where they should have time and opportunity to make their defence; but, if convicted, should be removed from their offices, and subjected to such other punishment as shall be thought proper.
example.cite: John Adams, Thoughts on Government, Applicable to the Present State of the American Colonies (Philadelphia 1776)
